year_bridge: No 2024 distribution extrapolation; 2026 observations and provisional 2027 scenarios separate.
base_sum_rule: Exact sum of assessed charged bases, in euro cents, or explicit null. Rounded published sums require a separate uncertainty adapter; no midpoint imputation.
unknown_count_rule: Null, suppressed, rounded or missing counts cannot be costed as zero. Keep unresolved outside the executable standard input.
aggregation_rules: Statutory assessment cases, not persons, bank transfers or raw mBGM tariff blocks.
Combine amounts or split employment records according to applicable assessment rules before binning.
Ordinary and special assessments remain separate; co-period special amounts must be reconciled.
Deliver mutually exclusive intervals per legal group and period; deduplicate corrections and reconcile totals.
Provide only aggregate tables, no names or personal identifiers.
Assessed contributions and cash receipts are different measures; reconcile collection timing and employer/employee allocation.
